svg.title: All sixteen entries of each tensor, all sixteen individual stencil derivatives, and all four diver- gences are extracted on the same filter. Explicitly these are the origin functions Jb ij(0), elmi Jb ij(0), and P i elmi Jb ij(0), for b = ∅, sh, sc. The tensor entries have degree-four coefficient records and the derivatives have degree-five records. These records include both the finite-cutofflabel and its retained limit; extraction of the joint correlation book gives the corresponding fields Li, Ωi, ∆i. Thus extraction of a divergence is extraction of the sum of its actual finite derivatives, not an independently selected vector limit.
